provider.description: Configured provider ID. Copy together with model from inspect models[].start_selectors when the user requests a model choice; omitted provider inherits the parent provider. Changes require human confirmation.

model.description: Configured model ID, not a provider/model concatenation. Copy together with provider from the same inspect models[].start_selectors candidate when the user requests a model choice. Changes require human confirmation.

reasoning_effort.description: Supported effort ID for the selected model. Omit unless explicitly requested by the user; changes require human confirmation.

checkpoint_seq.description: Exact safe checkpoint seq returned by inspect; revert only.

max_steps.description: Optional cumulative step limit for this child task; not user turns, tool count or a money budget. No default limit.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional wall timeout from admission, including queued waits. No default; cannot be reset by send, restart or revert.

tool_allowlist.description: Optional subset of tools currently available to the parent. [] means no tools; omitted inherits. Cannot add capabilities.
